function: Learned downlink pilot design and near-field channel estimation (A-RCE), plus sparse reconstruction of the channel for low-overhead CSI feedback (TFIST) (p. 1-4)
system: FDD XL-MIMO OFDM, 256-antenna ULA base station, one single-antenna user, 256 subcarriers, 100 GHz, 100 MHz bandwidth, near-field; no RIS (p. 2, 4)
method: Dense pilot layer, attention-based residual CNN (A-RCE), deep-unfolded FISTA (TFIST); supervised end-to-end training on channel reconstruction error, Adam optimizer, 300 epochs (p. 3-4)
data_channel: Own simulator: near-field spherical-wave model with P=6 paths, user/scatter distances U(5, 10) m; 32,000 training and 8,000 validation samples (p. 4)
test_conditions: Same simulated channel distribution for training and validation; SNR swept 5-30 dB, pilot length L and unfolded layers T varied; no unseen scenario (p. 4-5)
baselines: Non-learned LS and P-SOMP [5]; learned Channelformer [14] and CNN-based DRN (CDRN) [16]; proposed scheme without the spatial attention module (p. 5)
metrics: NMSE against SNR, training epochs, pilot length and unfolded layers; complexity as O(.), parameters, FLOPs and running time (p. 4-5)
complexity: Table I: proposed O(LNB^2+NB(3^2*32*2+2)), 0.75 M parameters, 16.26 M FLOPs, 2.18 ms running time, compared with LS, P-SOMP, Channelformer, CDRN (p. 5)
q1_support: p. 4: "The channel H is generated according to (2)"; (2) is a custom near-field spherical-wave model with P=6 paths, so no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is used.
q2_support: p. 4: "The training dataset and validation dataset include 32000 and 8000 channel samples, respectively"; results sweep SNR (Fig. 5), pilot length and layers (Fig. 4), with no test on a scenario, band, antenna count or dataset unseen in training.
q3_support: p. 5: "least squares (LS), P-SOMP [5], Channelformer [14], and CNN-based DRN (CDRN) [16]"; LS and P-SOMP are non-learned, Channelformer and CDRN are earlier learned estimators, all compared on NMSE (Fig. 5).
q4_support: p. 5: "floating point operations (FLOPs), and running time"; Table I lists complexity order, parameters, FLOPs and running time, with 0.75 M parameters, 16.26 M FLOPs and 2.18 ms for the proposed scheme.
q5_support: p. 4: "The channel H is generated according to (2)"; the data are self-simulated, and the letter gives no code or data link, DOI, or public dataset.
notes: The user has one antenna but the base station has 256, so the system check passes. Channel estimation and CSI feedback by sparse reconstruction are both area 2. The channel is a custom near-field simulator following [4], [5], so q1 is 0. Table I values were read from the rendered page image.
